verdict.rationale: Cline offers only indirect isolation. Kanban runs agents in isolated git worktrees, checkpoints and one-click undo let you revert changes, and Plan mode is read-only with no file edits or command execution. None of this is a real sandbox runtime or environment that keeps agent-run tests away from production data or services, and commands otherwise run in your own terminal. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandboxed or containerized execution environment, data or environment isolation from production, documented test/staging environment support, and independent hands-on corroboration.
